format: JavaScript (Node.js with ES Modules syntax, .mjs extension)
description: This file sets up a serverless agent using the @agentfield/sdk, configures routes for reasoning and relay functions, and creates an HTTP server to handle incoming requests.

methods.name: loadSdk
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the @agentfield/sdk module from several candidate paths or defaults.

methods.name: agent.reasoner

methods.name: agent.handler
